results.text: 2026-10-09 Linux restart review for Nous Wave at commit de9ca74: Pre-change configuration state: three concept activation parameters (inferred Tag retention8, similarity0.72, model catalog32) were owned by a static parser outside ConfigurationService. results.text: Context: 2026-10-09 Linux architecture review of Nous Wave, associated with source commit 663782c. Prior serving behavior: Serving previously used duplicated implementation identity across both typed records and metadata, with manually incremented counters. An actual PostgreSQL regression case showed the old serving path incorrectly reused an asset even when current metadata was retained and the typed implementation identity was marked outdated. Current serving behavior: Serving now reads the typed record and uses a build content digest derived from the projection implementation, input projections, and locked dependencies. The same Authority watermark rebuilds when implementation identity changes. Current and historical snapshots share the same asset installation. Configuration and identity rules: Native Wave configuration registration is separate from graph construction. Source mutations change implementation identity; exposure-only policy edits and CRLF/LF line normalization preserve implementation identity. Cognition, exact revisions, provenance, and purge semantics retain their existing owners. Instance status notes: Windows Portable previously completed real Doubao formation, embedding, query, use, and restart continuation. The Linux environment is creating a fresh independent instance; this source does not claim a new Windows Portable run.
